track.why: 8 Aug 2021, summited (summit 2 m), start and end 5 m apart at Mowich Lake. Logged route 'Up Flett Glacier, approach from southwest side'; report says out and back on the Spray Park trail. Line goes Mowich Lake, Spray Park, up the Flett and onto the summit from the south, matching our text. The other route on the peak (North Face, ice) is a different climb this track does not touch. Needs the Mowich Lake trailhead pin proposed below to count as complete.

facts.text: By August the Flett Glacier is mostly bare ice with snow left only along its edges; microspikes and an axe handled it for most parties.
By late September and early October the glacier is hard blue ice with step-over crevasses and meltwater channels, so aluminum crampons are the safer choice than spikes.
Rockfall peels off Echo Rock onto the east side of the Flett in August
Scree beside the glacier can sit on bare ice in late September; stay on the glacier surface instead
Going from Echo's base to Observation, descend to the glacier and use the boot path rather than side-hilling loose scree.
Many August parties go over Knapsack Pass (about an hour from the lake) and drop to the Spray Park trail, returning by the trail.
Budget about 12 to 13 miles round trip and roughly 3,800 to 4,200 ft of gain.
Early August brings mosquitoes at the lake and through Spray Park; carry repellent.

notes: North Face (ice) is a separate stored route, not touched. The WTA hike page currently states the Fairfax Bridge on the Mowich road is closed to all traffic, which would add many miles to the approach; worth checking before publishing the approach as written. Matching tracks lack only the trailhead pin; adding it makes them complete.
